fields.title: PDF text reads natively on Windows arm64
fields.description: The Windows arm64 install reads PDFs with the native `@napi-rs/canvas` binding instead of polyfills. An npm override pins `@napi-rs/canvas` to 0.1.100, the first 0.1.x line with a win32-arm64 package, and the lockfile is regenerated. A pdfkit-generated fixture extracts the same text natively inside both packaged builds. The release runbook's native checks then require each architecture's binding.
fields.notes: origin: Findings F-012 (Blurby.Brain1 asar comparison, RC merge `c5bb507f`, 2026-11-03); fix ruling by Blurby.Brain1 2026-11-03. Touches `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, one new test and `RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md` only; no shared core. Built on RodneySr (x64), arm64 package and launch on Rodney.
